name: Rivulet
summary: A quiet, multi-user RSS/Atom reader with folders, starring, keyboard-first reading, and background refresh.

manualSteps.title: Give each reader an account and project access
manualSteps.body: Rivulet installs private: every route (including /api/*) is gated behind sign-in, and each person's feeds and read/star state are scoped to their own account. Anyone who should use the reader needs a user account on this instance and access to the project the app installed into (the guest role is enough — guests can use the app without seeing the admin backend). A single-admin instance needs nothing here: your admin account already has access.

manualSteps.title: Allow inline embeds if this project uses cross-origin isolation
manualSteps.body: Rivulet renders a Handoff markdown post's body inline by iframing the Handoff viewer's chromeless ?embed=1 mode. If this project applies a cross-origin-isolation policy (COOP/COEP) elsewhere (e.g. another app using SharedArrayBuffer), add a response-header rule matching the reader's files (apps/reader/**) with Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: unsafe-none and Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: unsafe-none, at a priority below the isolating rule, and ensure the Handoff instance allows the reader's origin to frame it. A fresh project with no isolation policy needs nothing here.
